status: Inert oracles only; application decoding, rendering, units and native checks UNRUN at triage

encodingPolicy.rule: Keep existing BOM / UTF-8 / inferred / Latin-1 decoding. No invented rejection policy. Show errors only on actual read or decode failure; retain last successful document state.
encodingPolicy.oracleBoundary: Invalid UTF-8 is not unsupported text under the approved policy. Compatibility fixtures are expected to decode through the existing fallbacks, not to produce rejection alerts. Exact Foundation-inferred non-ASCII scalars are intentionally unspecified. Triage inspected bytes, not Foundation results; report actual worker results and any discrepancy without changing decoder policy to force an oracle. No universal all-input decode guarantee is asserted. A defensive decode error is tested by explicit injection, never by claiming these bytes reject.

directoryInventory.oracle: Explicit document-opening rejects a directory despite its .md name; do not read inside.txt as document content. Existing explicit local links to directories keep their external-opening policy.

decodeAndRenderCases.note: Strip the initial UTF-8 BOM; do not present U+FEFF as content.

decodeAndRenderCases.normalizationOracle: Strict UTF-8 source with CRLF then CR replaced by LF, otherwise identical Unicode scalars. Preserve internal U+FEFF, U+200B and combining sequences; do not NFC-normalize.
decodeAndRenderCases.codeText:
let greeting = "héllo 🌍" // CRLF code line
let tab = "\t"
print(greeting)
decodeAndRenderCases.note: Rendered prose soft breaks may become spaces. Assert scalars per known leaf/text segment, not whole source equality. Visible glyphs/RTL/ZWJ shaping remain DEFERRED/UNRUN.

decodeAndRenderCases.oracle: Fallback compatibility; nonempty decoded/rendered text with ASCII sentinels retained. Do not pin inferred replacement/non-ASCII scalars or assert a native rejection.
Incomplete four-byte UTF-8 sequence ends after f0 9f 8e; existing fallback should retain complete ASCII prefix. No rejection rule.

Exercise the existing permissive decode and bounded render without crash; no legibility or exact inferred text oracle, no automatic links/apps execution. NUL-containing source is fed to cmark with an explicit byte length. This is not an unsupported-encoding rejection fixture.

Render and release bounded nested input; text sentinels survive best-effort parsing. The standalone 5000 asterisks are a thematic break, not unmatched emphasis and not text that must remain literal. Do not demand parser-internal depth/IDs or claim arbitrary-input no-crash proof. No extreme lifecycle/performance script.

decodeAndRenderCases.setup: Inject MarkdownTextDecoder.Failure.unrecognizedTextEncoding into the pure error mapping/staging seam
decodeAndRenderCases.note: Explicit defensive branch coverage only; not a fixture-derived rejection or authorization to make a byte sequence fail.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: Owned temporary missing .md path; also ENOENT/ENOTDIR and Cocoa no-such-file errors, direct and wrapped
explicitOpenFailureCases.recoveryMeaning: Locate the moved/renamed/deleted file or reconnect its volume, then open again.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: Inject EACCES/EPERM and Cocoa read-no-permission; optional owned chmod(0) fixture only when actual credentials deny access
explicitOpenFailureCases.recoveryMeaning: Check Finder file permissions and NeoMD access in System Settings > Privacy & Security; then retry.
explicitOpenFailureCases.note: Never infer actual TCC denial from chmod. Restore owned modes during cleanup; skip/report an inapplicable real denial rather than claim it passed.

explicitOpenFailureCases.recoveryMeaning: This is a folder; choose a Markdown file such as notes.md.
explicitOpenFailureCases.route: Explicit document opening only; keep external directory-link policy unchanged.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: Owned FIFO plus inert text marked executable; wrong-extension ordinary text
explicitOpenFailureCases.expectKind: unsuitableItem or existing inaccessible classification for a special file
explicitOpenFailureCases.oracle: Reject without blocking, executing or opening external apps. FIFO metadata probe or existing nonblocking RegularMarkdownRead unit only. Executable local-link disposition remains reveal-only; this rejection oracle concerns explicit document opening.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: Injected decoder Failure and Cocoa inapplicable string encoding, including underlying-error wrappers
explicitOpenFailureCases.recoveryMeaning: File is not readable as text; obtain/export a text or UTF-8 copy in its creating app and open again. NeoMD does not rewrite it.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: EIO/ENXIO, SnapshotFailure.unstable, Cocoa read-unknown/corrupt without a more specific underlying cause
explicitOpenFailureCases.recoveryMeaning: Check the file and connected volume; try opening again.
explicitOpenFailureCases.note: Cocoa corrupt alone does not establish an encoding failure. Prefer a specific inner read cause over broad wrappers.

explicitOpenFailureCases.setup: Bounded nested NSError underlying causes; outer generic with inner missing/denied/decode; deep or cyclic underlying chain
explicitOpenFailureCases.oracle: Classify specific cause without recursion overflow; retain original diagnostics, not raw domain/code strings in UI. Cancellation remains silent, including wrapped cancellation if supported by the wrapper seam.

explicitOpenFailureCases.mustContain: Full attempted absolute path, including spaces/Unicode; not merely basename or resolved symlink target
explicitOpenFailureCases.mustHave: Concise native title, readable reason and actionable recovery; pure text not executable Markdown/HTML
explicitOpenFailureCases.note: No arbitrary exact word/character limits: concise readable content and accurate action are required, not a newly approved copy spec.

routingAndPreservationCases.setup: Commit original PreparedReadingDocument and captured position; begin a new request; inject each failure at stage/read boundary
routingAndPreservationCases.expect: No replacement of prepared ID/text/URL/render/index, binding or captured position; other session untouched; no successful recent/history publication. begin intentionally increments generation and clears pending section, so compare those after begin rather than require pre-request identity.

routingAndPreservationCases.setup: Injected recording presenter only, with captured session/presentation/token
routingAndPreservationCases.expect: Live committed destination chooses its own sheet intent; no committed reader chooses app-modal intent; no key-window lookup after await; closed/stale/superseded/canceled/terminating requests emit nothing. No actual NSAlert/window construction in units.

routingAndPreservationCases.setup: Ordinary and additional-reader requests with injected classifier/open/report closures; source remains live or is replaced/closed/superseded during await
routingAndPreservationCases.expect: Failure addresses only the live captured source, never reserved destination or unrelated reader. Preserve independent successful additional-reader routing. No commit; release owned reservation; no production NSWorkspace/presenter action.

routingAndPreservationCases.setup: Pure error-wrapping/delivery-decision seam for native completion route
routingAndPreservationCases.expect: One enriched path-bearing failure completion; do not also self-present and create a duplicate alert. Cancellation unchanged. Native controller route itself is source-traced, not hosted in units.

routingAndPreservationCases.setup: Existing #23 in-memory source with automaticPolling=false and logical ticks; inject missing/denied/I/O/decoder errors then same or changed readable content
routingAndPreservationCases.expect: Keep last good payload and captured position, quiet deduplicated refresh status separate from notices/native explicit error; retry without new event; clear status on recovery. No changes to #23 presenter/retry policy.

immutabilityCases.setup: Copy each regular .md fixture to an owned temporary directory, record exact bytes and nanosecond mtime; five direct RegularMarkdownRead.data -> decode -> render -> new session commit/close cycles
immutabilityCases.expect: Exact bytes and mtime unchanged after each reader cycle; no sidecars; descriptor closes via existing defer. session.close is model-only, NOT NSDocument/window close proof. Never read/write production history.

immutabilityCases.setup: Owned missing path or nonregular/inert executable file; optional actual denied file with setup/restore mutations outside comparison interval
immutabilityCases.expect: Failed read/probe does not alter owned target bytes/mtime or last good session. Compare after setup and before cleanup. Do not demand ctime unchanged across intentional chmod or atime unchanged across reads.
